Last Updated:
Bengaluru is expected to remain warm, with maximum temperatures likely to hover between 31°C and 33°C. The broader rise in temperatures signals a hotter spell ahead in many areas.

Temperatures across the state are rising steadily, with many already feeling the impact of the intense heat.
